title: Deja Vu Stage 5 probe receipt
description: One receipt per candidate probed at Full tier (references/snowball-probe.md; policy/tier-matrix.json's hands_on_probe lane). Captures enough of the sandboxed run -- or, when no enforceable sandbox exists, the reason none ran -- that a skeptical reader can reproduce the verdict without re-running the hunt or trusting transcript memory.

candidate.description: Name or URL of the probed candidate.

oneOf.description: Pinned commit SHA, tag, or package version actually probed -- never a moving branch ref.

source_revision.description: Null only when hands_on_probe is unsupported and no source was fetched at all.

inspected_manifests.description: Install/setup scripts and lockfile-adjacent manifests read before any execution.

commands.description: Exact install/build/smoke-test commands actually run inside the sandbox.

sandbox_mechanism.description: The enforceable disposable sandbox actually used -- container, VM, or OS-level sandbox mechanism. Never a scratch directory or changed $HOME.

mounts.description: Must stay empty. A non-empty list documents a sandbox violation (secrets, credentials, or the working repo reachable), not a pass.

writable_scratch.description: The bounded writable area the sandbox exposed, e.g. its path or size limit.

outputs.description: What the commands actually returned or produced.

load_bearing_source_read.description: Paths of the load-bearing source read after the sandboxed run.

failures.description: Any errors or anomalies observed. An empty array records that none occurred; omission does not.

unsupported_reason.description: Why no enforceable sandbox was available.

fallback_evidence.description: The weaker substitute evidence actually gathered instead, e.g. a static source read or an architecture_qa (DeepWiki) answer.
